recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If .NET class generation from the XHTML schema is again a work-group priority, open a fresh issue that explicitly balances code-generation compatibility against the current FHIR XHTML subset constraints instead of editing the active schema under this historical DSTU1 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3060 was Published/Persuasive for the Initial Draft and asked HL7 either to stop embedding XHTML as XML or to fix the circular group-reference problems in xhtml1-strict.xsd that blocked .NET schema code-generation tools. The recorded 2014 disposition kept XML XHTML narrative and said the schemas were flattened and simplified to aid code generation while preserving resource wire format and limiting XHTML to the approved FHIR subset.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-3060. The relevant historical application appears to be commit 6bf66c167c, which added source/fhir-xhtml.xsd and described it as a modified XHTML schema made acceptable for the .NET xsd.exe importer, plus later publishing infrastructure that ships fhir-xhtml.xsd rather than the original xhtml1-strict.xsd as the FHIR schema artifact.
additional_context: FHIR-12281 later found that the .NET-friendly fhir-xhtml.xsd did not enforce FHIR's ban on active XHTML, forms, objects, and related content. Commit f5e1ff77b8 replaced that schema with the current pared-down FHIR XHTML schema to enforce the narrative rules. In the current build, publish.ini lists fhir-xhtml.xsd, xml.xsd, and xmldsig-core-schema.xsd as published schema artifacts; remaining xhtml1-strict references are either W3C provenance comments or MIF-support material outside the current FHIR schema publication list.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the old flattened no-group schema, or doing a broad XHTML schema refactor, would risk undoing the later FHIR-12281 conformance fix and is not required to make the current specification correct for the published schema surface.

related_jiras.note: Replaced the earlier fhir-xhtml.xsd with the current restricted schema so the published schema enforces FHIR narrative XHTML bans.
